target_mesh.note: Pre-normalized, watertight head imported by scripts/import_head_mesh.py; presets/head_2.json records its source and transform. Set to null to carve the analytic ellipsoid preset instead.

frames.machine: right-handed, +Z up, origin on the orbit axis at the stock seat plane, theta=0 when the column is on +X
frames.wax: right-handed cylindrical, wax static, theta_s = theta = orbit-ring angle

stock.note: Cylindrical stock dimensions are owner-configurable and unverified until measured; the CAD block is only a placeholder.

theta_limits_deg.reason: Orbit travel is bounded by the stop block, but the contact angle cannot be computed unambiguously from the CAD bboxes; this conservative range is configuration, not a CAD measurement.
